Class.Finish_Desc:
All settings are complete.
To change previous settings, click the #bBACK#k button.
To proceed with the character creation, click the #bFINISH#k button.
#rOnce the character is created, it cannot be undone.#k
Class.Step4_M_Desc:

#rSkill Description:#k This skill boosts up the amount of increase on MaxMP after each Level Up or AP used on MaxMP; Required Skill: #bAt least Level 5 on Improving MP Recovery.#k
